### Observed differences

- In the later window, A33, A35, A36, A37, A38, and A39 occur in about 98 to 100 in 100 traces, whereas in the earlier window they occurred in about 48 to 52 in 100 traces. [OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008, OCC009]
- In the earlier window, A33/A35/A36 co-occurred in about 49 in 100 traces and A37/A38/A39 in about 52 in 100, with almost no co-occurrence between the groups; in the later window, the two groups co-occur pairwise in about 98 to 99 in 100 traces, with A33/A35/A36 before A37/A38/A39 in about 97 to 98 in 100 traces and both orders still common within each group. [REL037, REL038, REL042, REL039, REL040, REL041, REL043, REL044, REL045, REL046, REL047, REL048, REL049, REL050, REL051]
- A30's outgoing transitions shifted from about 14 to 18 in 100 to each of A33-A39 to about 30 to 37 in 100 to A33/A35/A36 and about 1 in 100 or less to A37/A38/A39; A33, A35, and A36 shifted away from A31 toward A37/A38/A39. [DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, DIR009]
- A14, A15, A16, and A30 were present in all traces in both windows; in the earlier window, they were with A33/A35/A36 in about half of traces and with A37/A38/A39 in about half of traces, while in the later window they are with both groups in about 98 to 99 in 100 traces. [REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015, REL016, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL022, REL023, REL024, REL025, REL026, REL027, REL028, REL029, REL030]
- A04 decreased from about 31 in 100 traces to about 14 in 100; in the earlier window it occurred without A33/A35/A36 in about 18 in 100 traces and without A37/A38/A39 in about 13 in 100 traces, while in the later window it occurs almost only with both groups in about 13 to 14 in 100 traces; its position became more variable, with the upper quartile moving from about 27 in 100 to 60 in 100 of the trace length. [OCC001, POS001, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006]
- Mean positions of A33/A35/A36 moved earlier, from about 74 to 75 in 100 of the trace length to about 67 to 68 in 100, while A37/A38/A39 moved later, from about 72 to 73 in 100 to about 76 to 77 in 100; A30 moved earlier, from about 67 to 62 in 100, and A31 moved later, from about 80 to 82 in 100. [POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, POS008, POS009, POS010, POS011]
- Lags from A30 to A37/A38/A39 and from A33/A35/A36 to A31 shifted from 1 to 3 steps to 4 to 5 steps. [LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008]
- A06 and A10 increased from about 3 and 2 to 3 in 100 traces to about 11 to 12 in 100, with support of 6 to 22 and 5 to 24 traces; routing from A02 and A08 also redistributed, but with small support of 13 to 23 and 9 to 28 outgoing transitions. [OCC002, OCC003, DIR001, DIR003]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

- The evidence supports the hypothesis that, in the later window, A30 routes to the A33/A35/A36 group, which then routes to the A37/A38/A39 group, with mixed order within each group, so both groups are executed in almost all traces; in the earlier window, A30 routed to either the A33/A35/A36 group or the A37/A38/A39 group, so only one of the two groups was executed in each trace, with each group appearing in about half of traces. [DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, DIR009, REL025, REL026, REL027, REL028, REL029, REL030, REL037, REL038, REL042, REL039, REL040, REL041, REL043, REL044, REL045, REL046, REL047, REL048, REL049, REL050, REL051, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008, OCC009]
- Supporting signs are the rise in participation of A33-A39, the near-complete pairwise co-occurrence of the two groups, the shift of A30's outgoing transitions from both groups to the first group, the shift of A33/A35/A36 outgoing transitions from A31 to A37/A38/A39, the earlier position of A30, and the later positions and 4 to 5 step lags for A37/A38/A39 after A30/A33/A35/A36. [OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008, OCC009, REL039, REL040, REL041, REL043, REL044, REL045, REL046, REL047, REL048, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, DIR009, POS004, POS009, POS010, POS011, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008]
- This is not merely a shift among existing alternatives because the two groups, which were almost never together before, are now together in almost all traces. [REL039, REL040, REL041, REL043, REL044, REL045, REL046, REL047, REL048]
- The number of qualifying control-flow items is far above the chance expectation, so the pattern is not what an unchanged process typically produces. [screening]
- Limitations are that the windows are finite samples, some routing items rest on few outgoing transitions, and the evidence cannot rule out a change in the population of cases that makes the A33-A39 block more common. [screening, DIR001, DIR003, OCC001, OCC002, OCC003]
- Other differences: A14, A15, A16, and A31 now co-occur with A33-A39 in almost all traces, with A31 after A33-A39; A04 became less frequent and almost only occurs with A33-A39; A06 and A10 became more frequent; routing from A02 and A08 redistributed with small support. [REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015, REL016, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL022, REL023, REL024, REL031, REL032, REL033, REL034, REL035, REL036, OCC001, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, OCC002, OCC003, DIR001, DIR003]
